concept: Building a consistent practice habit around something that matters to you
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student designs a realistic practice schedule for a skill or goal they genuinely care about, accounting for real obstacles (time, motivation dips)
exercise.branching_choice: Student adjusts the plan when a realistic obstacle (missed day, low motivation) is introduced
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how to recover from a broken streak without giving up entirely

assessment.success_marker: student proposes a realistic recovery response rather than an all-or-nothing framing
